goal: Play like a new player for the first few minutes: get your plot (walk onto a CLAIM gate or wait for auto-claim), watch cash come in, walk onto the glowing green Dropper 2 buy pad as soon as you can afford it, keep buying the next pads as they appear and watch your plot grow, open the SHOP with the SHOP button and buy upgrades there, press REBIRTH once you can afford it, look at the TOP TYCOONS board in the plaza, and report anything confusing, broken or unfair
summary: The playtester used the SHOP (Cash x1.5, Gold Ore, Speed 2, Dropper 4, Speed 1, Silver Ore) and checked that Owned buttons did nothing. It pressed REBIRTH while short of cash, then again at 100% (step 12), after which cash reset to about $60 and the price rose to $20K. The probe shows 0 server errors, a plot claimed and 547 cubes collected. The trace never shows the TOP TYCOONS board being viewed, and the playtester never walked onto a Dropper 2 pad. The main shop and rebirth loop was exercised, so the goal counts as mostly met, with those gaps.

bugs.title: Shop 'Owned' state disagrees with world pads and HUD
bugs.evidence: Card_dropper3 and Card_mult1 read 'Owned' (steps 3, 8, 15), but the HUD still showed 'Droppers: 2' and the pads 'Dropper 3 | $40' and 'Cash x1.5 | $300' were still listed as buyable (steps 9-10, 18). After rebirth, buying Dropper 2 in the shop (step 13) also reported 'Upgraded: Dropper 3' (step 14). The pad labels and HUD counters look stale or out of sync with shop ownership.

bugs.title: Pad shown as buyable but cannot be touched
bugs.evidence: Step 9: go_touch on UpgradePad_dropper3 returned done=False ('never touched'), yet the pad stayed in the touch list ('Dropper 3 | $40') through step 18 while the shop listed Dropper 3 as Owned. A player is told to walk onto a pad that does nothing.

bugs.title: Rebirth gives little feedback when cash is short, and the price change is unexplained
bugs.evidence: Steps 5 and 7: REBIRTH pressed at 20% and 39% of cost, and the probe counted rebirth_denied=8. The only visible change was the percentage on the button label. After the step 12 rebirth the cost doubled from $10.0K to $20.0K with no on-screen explanation, and progress reset to 0%.

bugs.title: Rebirth progress percent differs between HUD label and button
bugs.evidence: Step 10: the HUD shows 'REBIRTH $10.0K (81%)' while RebirthGui.RebirthButton shows 83% in the same observation, so one of them updates late.

bugs.title: Income dropped after buying upgrades
bugs.evidence: The playtester reported income falling from +$122/s to +$95/s around the rebirth attempts, and from +$18/s to +$16/s right after buying Silver Ore (step 17-18). Much of this may be the rebirth reset, but the Silver Ore drop was unexplained and could be a stale or wrong income readout.
